title: Time Machine: Running the DMZ - Korea on the Frontlines
original_title: Time Machine: Running the DMZ - Korea on the Frontlines
overview: On the 50th anniversary for the signing of the Korea War Armistice we take you back in history to explain how the conflict between North and South Korea started, yet is not over. It is only an agreed cease fire agreement. What show the viewer is how the hostility is far from over and continues to this day. the escalation continues as sure as the sun rises in the east.
